products.title: Nord Oak Lounge Chair
products.description: A low lounge chair on a solid white-oak frame, hand-shaped and oiled, with a slung seat you sink into and a back angled for an evening rather than a meeting. Made to be re-upholstered, never replaced.
products.seoTitle: Nord Oak Lounge Chair — solid white-oak lounge chair
products.seoDescription: A hand-shaped solid white-oak lounge chair with a slung, re-upholsterable seat.

products.title: Walnut Turned Stool
products.description: A little stool turned from a single billet of walnut — a seat, a side table, a step to the top shelf. Finished with hard wax oil that you can refresh with a cloth in five minutes.
products.seoTitle: Walnut Turned Stool — solid walnut stool
products.seoDescription: A stool turned from a single billet of solid walnut, finished in hard wax oil.

products.title: Travertine Side Table
products.description: A round side table cut from a single piece of unfilled travertine, its top honed smooth and its edges left soft. Heavy, cool to the touch, and completely at home beside the lounge chair.
products.seoTitle: Travertine Side Table — solid stone side table
products.seoDescription: A round side table cut from a single piece of unfilled honed travertine.

products.title: Linen-Shade Floor Lamp
products.description: A slim brass stem carrying a hand-sewn linen drum that throws a warm, even light. Dimmable in the base, weighted so it stays put, and tall enough to read beneath from a low chair.
products.seoTitle: Linen-Shade Floor Lamp — dimmable brass floor lamp
products.seoDescription: A slim brass floor lamp with a hand-sewn linen drum shade, dimmable at the base.

products.title: Paper-Shade Pendant
products.description: A folded paper pendant that glows like a lantern and packs flat when you move. Comes with three metres of braided cord and a ceiling cup in the same brass as the lamp.
products.seoTitle: Paper-Shade Pendant — folded paper pendant light
products.seoDescription: A folded paper pendant lamp with braided cord and a brass ceiling cup.

products.title: Hand-Thrown Ceramic Carafe
products.description: A one-litre carafe thrown on the wheel and glazed in a soft matte white that breaks to clay at the rim. Balanced to pour without a drip, and happy on the table or beside the bed.
products.seoTitle: Hand-Thrown Ceramic Carafe — one-litre matte carafe
products.seoDescription: A one-litre hand-thrown ceramic carafe in a soft matte white glaze.

products.title: Stoneware Vase Set
products.description: A pair of stoneware vases — one tall and narrow, one low and wide — glazed in a speckled oatmeal that suits a single stem or a whole armful. Sold together, made to sit apart.
products.seoTitle: Stoneware Vase Set — pair of speckled stoneware vases
products.seoDescription: A pair of speckled-oatmeal stoneware vases, one tall and one low.

products.title: Lambswool Throw
products.description: A generously sized throw woven from British lambswool with a soft brushed face and a fringed edge. Warm without weight, and the kind of thing that ends up on whoever gets to the sofa first.
products.seoTitle: Lambswool Throw — brushed British lambswool throw
products.seoDescription: A generously sized brushed British-lambswool throw with a fringed edge.

products.title: Mohair Cushion
products.description: A deep, plush mohair cushion with a feather-down pad and a hidden zip, backed in brushed cotton. One on a bench reads as a decision; three reads as a room.
products.seoTitle: Mohair Cushion — plush mohair cushion with down pad
products.seoDescription: A deep plush mohair cushion with a feather-down pad and a hidden zip.

products.title: Leather Magazine Sling
products.description: A saddle-leather sling that hangs a stack of magazines off the arm of a chair instead of the floor. Vegetable-tanned, riveted by hand, and made to darken with use.
products.seoTitle: Leather Magazine Sling — saddle-leather magazine holder
products.seoDescription: A hand-riveted vegetable-tanned saddle-leather magazine sling.

products.title: Cork Serving Tray
products.description: A light, warm serving tray pressed from a single slab of cork with a solid oak lip. Quiet to set down, kind to glasses, and it floats if you ever drop it in the sink.
products.seoTitle: Cork Serving Tray — cork tray with oak lip
products.seoDescription: A light cork serving tray pressed from a single slab with a solid oak lip.

products.title: Brass Candleholder
products.description: A turned solid-brass candleholder with a weighted base and a wide drip dish, sized for a standard dinner candle. Left unlacquered, so it takes on a patina that a polish brings straight back.
products.seoDescription: A turned solid-brass candleholder with a weighted base and wide drip dish.
